title: Companies
description: Manage companies by relationship stage, owner, and latest permitted activity.

list.exportQueued: Export job accepted. Track progress in the job queue.
list.exportFilterUnsupported: Export does not support the selected owner/archive filters.
list.mergeNeedTwo: Select exactly two companies to request a merge
list.emptyDescription: Add a company directly or start with an import. Duplicate candidates are reviewed via merge requests.
list.emptyFiltered: No companies match the current filters

form.name: Company name
form.countryInvalid: Country code must be two uppercase letters (e.g. KR)
form.ownerHint: Assigning another member as owner requires reassignment permission.
form.ownerFixed: Owner changes use a separate reassignment workflow.
form.conflictReload: Load the latest values to compare
form.conflictApplyError: Could not save with the selected values

duplicates.title: Review duplicate candidates
duplicates.description: A company with the same domain already exists. Creation succeeded, but companies are never merged on domain alone. Review and request a merge if needed.

merge.title: Request company merge
merge.description: Merges the source company into the target. The request is processed via the job queue, and you can choose which value to keep per field.
merge.reasonPlaceholder: Why you believe these are duplicates
merge.error: Could not send the merge request
merge.forbidden: Merge requests require Manager or Admin role
merge.sameCompany: A company cannot be merged into itself

detail.archivedBanner: This company is archived. It is hidden from lists by default and related work is flagged for review.
detail.archiveDescription: Archive this company. Archiving is not deletion, and it does not mark contacts or addresses as unsubscribed.
detail.archiveReasonPlaceholder: Why this company is being archived
detail.notFound: Company not found or you do not have access

contactsTab.emptyDescription: Add a contact for this company to manage per-address verification and send permission.

activity.title: Activity timeline
activity.permittedOnly: Only activities you are permitted to see are shown
activity.emptyDescription: Mail, meetings, notes and tasks appear here only when you have access.
activity.emptyMailDescription: Mail activity is not shown at all without mailbox read permission.
activity.emptyMeetingDescription: Booking activity linked to this company will appear here.

researchTab.title: Research
researchTab.description: Research evidence and lead candidates for this company are managed by the research review feature. AI-filled fields without a source are marked unverified.
researchTab.emptyDescription: Once the research review feature is connected, per-field evidence and review status appear here.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Leave a note about this company
notes.emptyDescription: Notes are also recorded in the activity timeline.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.emptyDescription: Add follow-up work with an owner and a due date.

research.requestDescription: Requests an agent run to research this company. Candidates are not written to the CRM automatically — they go through review.
research.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Verify recent funding and main products
research.error: Could not send the research request
